build_pose3d_estimator: build a Pose3dTopdownEstimator with backbone, head, and pose3d_head config for 3D pose estimation
run_train_step: run a training step with data and optim_wrapper to compute losses and update model parameters
predict_3d_pose: predict 3D pose keypoints from input tensors and data samples using the topdown estimator
parse_losses_nan_handling: parse a dict of loss tensors into a total loss and log vars with nan spike handling
add_pred_to_datasample: add predicted keypoints and bbox info to data samples converting from input to image space
